title: Kicked Chicken Wrap
description: A Chinese-inspired wrap filled with kicked-up chicken and crunchy slaw. Perfect for a quick lunch or dinner.
instructions: 1. Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
2. In a small bowl, whisk together kicked sauce and soy sauce (if using).
3. Brush the mixture on both sides of the chicken breast.
4. Grill the chicken for 5-6 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
5. Let the chicken rest for 5 minutes before slicing.
6. In a large bowl, combine crunchy slaw and chopped scallions.
7. Warm the Ukrainian rye wrap by wrapping it in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
8. Assemble the wrap by spreading a layer of slaw on the bottom half of the wrap, followed by sliced chicken, and finally topping with sesame seeds (if using).
9. Drizzle with honey (if using) and serve immediately.
